items.root_cause: The engine and the guards each read a capture's size token and decide its KIND (weight, volume, count) separately, so a token they disagree on ('14 fl oz' on a weight-unit row, 'only $3.99/lb' in a name) prices a cell the guard then condemns: the cell wins the row in the engine and is quarantined at publish. Each prior close fixed one token at one store (de4f72, 92e552, b61b08, c70eb2) and none made the two readers one; the routed c70eb2 fix moved the price reader, not the kind reader.

root_fix.what: one size-KIND reader for the engine and audit-unit-basis-outlier: the engine refuses (or converts only by a declared commodity equivalence) a size whose kind differs from the row's unit before the row is crowned, so the guard and the engine cannot disagree and no such cell reaches publish
root_fix.exact_change: Export one function in pricing-math-lib.ps1 (e.g. Get-SizeKind) that classifies a size token as weight | volume | count; the engine's size branch calls it and, for an oz (weight) row, refuses a 'fl oz' size unless the commodity declares a fl-oz-as-weight equivalence; audit-unit-basis-outlier lifts the same function instead of its own classifier. Before landing: scratch-clone rebuild (chain copied from check-ad-cycles.ps1) and a full per_unit diff against comparison-2026-09-30; expected moves: condensed-milk/Aldi only. Any other move stops the item and is measured.

prevention.what: the engine's size reader, the producer of the per-unit the guard condemns: one KIND classification shared by engine and guard, so a cell the guard would refuse is never crowned
prevention.exact_change: as root_fix, plus compare-deals -SelfTest cases built from the frozen Aldi condensed-milk row and the frozen c70eb2 Fareway bacon row
